user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my best friend next week. Can you help me find some funny jokes to include in the party decorations? It would be great if you could also provide me with a list of joke categories to choose from. Lastly, can you recommend a good party planning tool to help me organize everything?

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of joke categories that can be used for decorations.
Search for funny jokes under the selected joke categories.
Recommend a good party planning tool that can help organize the birthday party.
